title: Elevated SOX9 Expression Is Associated With Extracellular Matrix Remodelling and Aggressive Clinicopathological Features in Extramammary Paget's Disease.
snippet: Extramammary Paget's disease (EMPD) is a rare cutaneous adenocarcinoma that remains clinically challenging in advanced or metastatic stages, yet the molecular mechanisms underlying tumour invasion and metastasis remain poorly understood. title: Integrated Multi-Omics and Radiogenomic Analysis Identifies S100B and ITGB5 as Complementary Candidate Biomarkers of Glioblastoma Heterogeneity.
snippet: Glioblastoma (GBM) is characterized by marked intratumoral heterogeneity, diffuse invasion, and a profoundly immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment. title: HuR-ΔNp63 Regulation and E-Cadherin Expression in Tumor Budding and Bone Remodeling of Ameloblastoma.
